games.title: 拼圖工坊
games.description: 轉動帶有真實凹凸榫槽的花窗拼片，讓內縫吻合、外緣成框。
games.normalization: Piece permutation, independent initial piece rotation, whole-board rotation/reflection and width/height interchange are removed. Colors, titles and scramble do not enter the key.
games.physicsModel: Four signed connector sizes give actual cubic-curve interlocking contours; every border must be flat and every interior pair complementary. Piece rotation is a cyclic permutation of its physical edges. Numbers and colors identify pieces only.

games.title: 滾方塊過橋
games.description: 翻滾長方塊穿越薄板、切換橋樑，以直立姿態落入出口。
games.normalization: Full typed map, start and goal under the eight dihedral plane symmetries. Map holes, terrain and goal are gameplay constraints.
games.physicsModel: Exact 1×1×2 integer-lattice rigid-body rolling. Weak tiles reject a standing block. An entered switch toggles the bridge after support checking, and lost support means a fall. A switch under an already occupied footprint does not retoggle.

games.title: 立方體展開圖
games.description: 把六個有方向的面接成紙網，摺出面向與箭頭都正確的立方體。
games.normalization: Allowed-cell geometry and anchor under translation plus all eight plane symmetries. Face labels are fixed geometric meanings, not cosmetic permutations.
games.physicsModel: A fixed front face supplies an orthonormal root frame. Each planar edge folds 90°. Breadth-first frame propagation rejects inconsistent cycles, duplicate normals, disconnected parts and incorrect labeled normal/arrow vectors.

games.title: 光影雕塑
games.description: 移動、旋轉立體零件，讓正面與斜向兩束光產生指定剪影。
games.normalization: Per-piece proper-rotation equivalence and piece relabeling, with paired horizontal and vertical projection reflection normalization. Target geometry and piece shapes are included; palette is excluded.
games.physicsModel: Polycube components occupy a bounded stage without overlap. The 24 proper cubic rotations are available. Two occluding silhouettes are set unions of (x,z) and (x+y,z) projected voxels. Components float; no support model is implied.

games.title: 三視圖積木
games.description: 用恰好的積木數量堆出同時符合上、正、側三視圖的模型。
games.normalization: Top mask, front/side height constraints and budget under all eight board rotations/reflections. The reference height field itself is not the identity.
games.physicsModel: A height field represents supported columns without gaps. Top projection is occupancy; front and side are maxima. All three projections and the exact integer voxel budget must hold. Every valid model is accepted.

games.title: 摺紙剪影
games.description: 把紙對摺、逐層剪孔，讓展開後的孔洞符合目標。
games.normalization: Target holes, fold count and cut budget under all eight rotations/reflections. Cosmetic drawing, title and witness choice do not enter the key.
games.physicsModel: An 8×8 sheet carries original-cell identities. Each fold reflects one half onto the other. A cut removes every original cell currently stacked under the selected folded cell. Cut order matters; wrong holes are irreversible until undo.

games.title: 齒輪工坊
games.description: 在雙平面軸位裝上齒輪，調出精確的輸出方向與轉速比。
games.normalization: Teeth and shaft distances are divided by their common scale factor; inventory permutation is removed. Shaft geometry, fixed input and required output ratio remain.
games.physicsModel: Pitch radius = tooth count ÷ 4. Same-plane gears mesh only at an exact sum-of-radii center distance; overlap is forbidden. Different-plane gears at the same x coordinate share a shaft and angular speed. Rational speed propagation rejects contradictory cycles.

games.title: 透明片疊色
games.description: 轉動並堆疊半透明色片，利用位置與前後順序合成目標。
games.normalization: All eight global plane symmetries, RGB channel permutations, layer relabeling and each mask’s free initial rotation. Mask shapes and target image are retained.
games.physicsModel: Three masks use exact 50% source-over compositing on white: output = (background + foreground) ÷ 2. RGB is represented in eighths, so there is no color tolerance or floating approximation. Order is noncommutative.

games.title: 重心建築師
games.description: 逐層擺放不同重量的樑板，用支撐與重心托住外伸載重。
games.normalization: Foundation translation and horizontal reflection are removed. Beam order, dimensions, mass and load location are physical constraints. This is an explicit static model, not dynamic rigid-body physics.
games.physicsModel: Every uniformly weighted beam sits at an integer x. For every interface, the center of mass of everything above it must be inside the nonempty overlap support interval. Moments use doubled integer coordinates. Boundary equality is stable. The final payload is checked at the flag.

games.title: 抽棒落球
games.description: 依序抽出儲球棒與岔道棒，把不同顏色的球送往正確容器。
games.normalization: Canonical unordered rooted routing tree plus each leaf’s source-ancestor distances. Color names, source order, drawing coordinates and independent left/right mirror permutations are removed.
games.physicsModel: Directed downhill tubes form a tree with gated source chambers. Closed source pins hold a ball; released packets immediately settle. Each router sends future balls left while pinned and right after removal. Pins cannot return. Balls do not collide and bins have unlimited capacity.
